import openpyxl
from openpyxl.worksheet.formula import ArrayFormula
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb.active
for r in range(2,42):
    f='=IF(I{r}=MAX(IF(\$C\$2:\$C\$41=C{r},\$I\$2:\$I\$41)),\"Latest\",\"Not Latest\")'.format(r=r)
    ws.cell(r,13).value = ArrayFormula('M{r}'.format(r=r), f)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
